meaning.en: To rummage through every box and cupboard in search of something.
meaning.zh: 把箱子柜子都翻遍了，形容彻底地翻找。

examples.zh: 为了找护照，他翻箱倒柜折腾了一晚上。
examples.en: He turned the flat upside down all night looking for his passport.

examples.zh: 小偷翻箱倒柜，却没找到什么值钱的东西。
examples.en: The burglars ransacked every drawer but found nothing of value.

examples.zh: 妈妈翻箱倒柜，终于找出了我小时候的照片。
examples.en: Mum rummaged through every cupboard and finally dug out my childhood photos.

pinyin: tiān shí dì lì rén hé
literal: heaven · timing · earth · advantage · people · harmony

meaning.en: Favourable timing, favourable position and popular support: all the conditions for success.
meaning.zh: 有利的时机、有利的地理条件和人心所向，指成功所需的各种条件都具备。

equivalents: the right time, the right place and the right people

examples.zh: 这次比赛我们占尽天时地利人和，一定要拿下。
examples.en: We have everything in our favour this time, so we must win.

examples.zh: 项目能成功，靠的是天时地利人和。
examples.en: The project succeeded because the time, the place and the people were all right.

examples.zh: 创业要讲天时地利人和，缺一不可。
examples.en: A start-up needs the right timing, location and team; you can't do without any of them.

story.en: Mencius: 'Favourable timing is not as good as favourable terrain, and favourable terrain is not as good as harmony among the people' (天时不如地利，地利不如人和).
story.zh: 《孟子·公孙丑下》：“天时不如地利，地利不如人和。”

usage.en: Object; often 占尽天时地利人和.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“占尽天时地利人和”。

meaning.en: Neat, swift and efficient, with nothing left untidy.
meaning.zh: 形容做事、动作或言语灵活敏捷，不拖泥带水；也指整洁有条理。

examples.zh: 他办事干净利落，从不拖拉。
examples.en: He gets things done cleanly and quickly, never dragging his feet.

examples.zh: 这个进球打得干净利落。
examples.en: That goal was a clinical finish.

examples.zh: 她把屋子收拾得干净利落。
examples.en: She left the room spick and span.

meaning.en: To make decisions alone and act without consulting anyone.
meaning.zh: 行事专断，不考虑别人的意见。

examples.zh: 老板独断专行，员工的意见他从来不听。
examples.en: The boss is high-handed and never listens to his staff.

examples.zh: 这样的大事，你不能独断专行。
examples.en: You can't decide something this big on your own.

examples.zh: 他因为独断专行，在董事会失去了支持。
examples.en: His arbitrary style cost him the support of the board.

meaning.en: To scheme deliberately and for a long time (usually to do harm).
meaning.zh: 蓄谋已久，费尽心机地盘算（多指坏事）。

examples.zh: 他处心积虑地想把对手挤出公司。
examples.en: He has been scheming for ages to push his rival out of the company.

examples.zh: 这是一场处心积虑的骗局。
examples.en: This was a carefully premeditated fraud.

examples.zh: 对方处心积虑，就是想抢走我们的客户。
examples.en: They've plotted at length just to steal our clients.

story.en: Commenting on Duke Zhuang of Zheng's treatment of his brother, the Guliang commentary says he had 'set his mind and laid his plans to kill' (处心积虑成于杀也).
story.zh: 《穀梁传·隐公元年》：“何甚乎郑伯？甚郑伯之处心积虑成于杀也。”

meaning.en: Simple and genuine, without showiness.
meaning.zh: 朴素实在，不浮华。

examples.zh: 他的文字朴实无华，却很打动人。
examples.en: His writing is plain and unadorned, yet very moving.

examples.zh: 这些老乡朴实无华，待人真诚。
examples.en: The villagers are down-to-earth and sincere.

examples.zh: 房间布置得朴实无华。
examples.en: The room is simply furnished.

antonyms: 孔夫子放屁——文（闻）气冲天

meaning.en: Gentle, kindly and easy to approach.
meaning.zh: 态度温和，容易接近。

examples.zh: 新来的校长和蔼可亲，学生们都喜欢他。
examples.en: The new head teacher is warm and approachable, and the pupils love him.

examples.zh: 奶奶总是一副和蔼可亲的样子。
examples.en: Grandma always looks so kindly.

examples.zh: 那位医生和蔼可亲，病人一点也不紧张。
examples.en: The doctor was so genial that the patients didn't feel nervous at all.

synonyms: 对待同志要像春天般温暖

meaning.en: A vast territory with few inhabitants.
meaning.zh: 地域广阔，人烟稀少。

examples.zh: 澳大利亚地广人稀。
examples.en: Australia is vast and sparsely populated.

examples.zh: 这里地广人稀，开车一小时也看不到一个村子。
examples.en: It's so empty here you can drive an hour without seeing a village.

examples.zh: 西部地广人稀，发展潜力很大。
examples.en: The sparsely populated west has huge potential.

meaning.en: To take advantage of a weak point to get in.
meaning.zh: 趁着对方空虚或薄弱时侵入。

examples.zh: 对方后防出现漏洞，我们的前锋乘虚而入。
examples.en: Their defence left a gap, and our striker slipped through.

examples.zh: 身体虚弱时，病毒很容易乘虚而入。
examples.en: When you're run down, viruses can easily take hold.

examples.zh: 大公司退出后，小品牌乘虚而入。
examples.en: When the big firms pulled out, smaller brands moved into the gap.

meaning.en: Split into many pieces; disunited.
meaning.zh: 形容分散、不完整、不团结。

examples.zh: 内战让这个国家四分五裂。
examples.en: The civil war tore the country apart.

examples.zh: 公司高层意见不合，团队已经四分五裂。
examples.en: The management is divided and the team has fallen apart.

examples.zh: 杯子摔在地上，四分五裂。
examples.en: The cup hit the floor and smashed to pieces.

story.en: Zhang Yi warned the King of Wei that his land, open on all sides, was 'the way of being split four ways and torn five ways' (四分五裂之道).
story.zh: 《战国策·魏策一》：“此所谓四分五裂之道也。”

meaning.en: Heroic in bearing and full of vigour.
meaning.zh: 形容英俊威武、精神焕发的样子。

examples.zh: 阅兵式上，女兵们英姿飒爽。
examples.en: At the parade the women soldiers looked magnificent.

examples.zh: 照片里的爷爷穿着军装，英姿飒爽。
examples.en: In the photo, Grandpa looks dashing in his uniform.

examples.zh: 她骑在马上，一副英姿飒爽的样子。
examples.en: On horseback she cut a gallant figure.

story.en: Du Fu describes the painted portraits of Tang generals: 'Their heroic bearing, brisk and bright, as if coming to fight' (英姿飒爽来酣战).
story.zh: 杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》：“褒公鄂公毛发动，英姿飒爽来酣战。”

meaning.en: So far behind that one can only see the dust of the one ahead; far inferior.
meaning.zh: 只能望见前面人马扬起的尘土而追赶不上，比喻远远落后。

examples.zh: 论数学，我对他望尘莫及。
examples.en: When it comes to maths, I can't hold a candle to him.

examples.zh: 这家公司的技术让同行望尘莫及。
examples.en: The company's technology leaves its rivals far behind.

examples.zh: 她的毅力是我们望尘莫及的。
examples.en: Her determination is way beyond anything we could manage.

story.en: When Zhao Zi passed through without stopping, the official Cao Hao rode after him but could only 'gaze at the dust, unable to catch up' (望尘不及).
story.zh: 《后汉书·赵咨传》：“暠送至亭次，望尘不及。”

meaning.en: Through an odd combination of chance mistakes.
meaning.zh: 比喻由于偶然的因素而造成了差错或意外的结果。

examples.zh: 阴差阳错，我们俩竟然坐上了同一班飞机。
examples.en: By a twist of fate, we ended up on the same flight.

examples.zh: 由于一连串阴差阳错，这封信晚了一个月才寄到。
examples.en: Thanks to a string of mix-ups, the letter arrived a month late.

examples.zh: 他阴差阳错地读了医学，后来却爱上了这一行。
examples.en: He ended up in medicine almost by accident, but came to love it.

usage.zh: 多放句首或作状语、定语。

meaning.en: To act when the other side least expects it.
meaning.zh: 趁对方没有意料到的时候采取行动。

examples.zh: 我们要出其不意，打对手一个措手不及。
examples.en: We need to catch our opponents off guard.

examples.zh: 这记任意球出其不意，守门员根本没反应过来。
examples.en: The free kick took the keeper completely by surprise.

examples.zh: 他出其不意地向她求婚了。
examples.en: He proposed to her out of the blue.

story.en: Sunzi: 'Attack where they are unprepared; appear where they do not expect you' (攻其无备，出其不意).
story.zh: 《孙子·计篇》：“攻其无备，出其不意。此兵家之胜，不可先传也。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often 出其不意，攻其不备.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，常与“攻其不备”连用。

meaning.en: To get to the heart of a matter by careful, step-by-step analysis.
meaning.zh: 像抽丝、剥茧一样，比喻层层深入地分析事物，找出真相。

examples.zh: 警方抽丝剥茧，终于找出了真凶。
examples.en: Detectives peeled back layer after layer and finally found the killer.

examples.zh: 老师抽丝剥茧地讲解这道难题。
examples.en: The teacher took the hard problem apart step by step.

examples.zh: 经过抽丝剥茧的分析，问题的根源找到了。
examples.en: Careful, methodical analysis revealed the root of the problem.

meaning.en: Countless mountains and rivers; a long and arduous journey.
meaning.zh: 形容路途遥远而艰险。

examples.zh: 他跨越千山万水来看望我。
examples.en: He came all that long way to see me.

examples.zh: 虽然隔着千山万水，我们的心是相连的。
examples.en: Though we're worlds apart, our hearts are linked.

examples.zh: 红军走过了千山万水。
examples.en: The Red Army crossed countless mountains and rivers.

usage.en: Object; often 跨越/隔着千山万水.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“跨越千山万水”。

meaning.en: Two things can be carried out at the same time without conflicting.
meaning.zh: 同时进行，互不冲突。

examples.zh: 经济发展和环境保护可以并行不悖。
examples.en: Economic growth and environmental protection can go hand in hand.

examples.zh: 工作与学习并行不悖。
examples.en: Work and study need not get in each other's way.

examples.zh: 这两种做法并行不悖，可以同时采用。
examples.en: The two approaches are compatible and can be used together.

story.en: The Doctrine of the Mean: 'All things are nourished together without harming one another; the ways run side by side without conflict' (道并行而不相悖).
story.zh: 《礼记·中庸》：“万物并育而不相害，道并行而不相悖。”

meaning.en: To rush about telling one another the news.
meaning.zh: 奔跑着互相转告，形容消息传得快、人们很关心。

examples.zh: 听说要修地铁，居民们奔走相告。
examples.en: When they heard a metro line was coming, residents rushed to tell each other.

examples.zh: 胜利的消息传来，人们奔走相告。
examples.en: When news of the victory arrived, it spread like wildfire.

examples.zh: 村里通了网，大家奔走相告。
examples.en: When the village got internet, everyone was telling everyone.

meaning.en: To answer every question that is asked.
meaning.zh: 只要有人问，就一定回答。

examples.zh: 王老师对学生有问必答。
examples.en: Mr Wang answers every question his students ask.

examples.zh: 客服人员有问必答，态度很好。
examples.en: The customer service staff answer every query, and they're very friendly.

examples.zh: 发布会上，他有问必答，毫不回避。
examples.en: At the press conference he answered every question without dodging any.

meaning.en: Intensive, indiscriminate bombing; figuratively, a relentless barrage.
meaning.zh: 猛烈而无节制地轰炸，也比喻连续不断的攻击或宣传。

examples.zh: 这座城市遭到敌机的狂轰滥炸。
examples.en: The city was carpet-bombed by enemy aircraft.

examples.zh: 我们每天都被广告狂轰滥炸。
examples.en: We're bombarded with adverts every day.

examples.zh: 下半场对方狂轰滥炸，我们只能死守。
examples.en: In the second half they threw everything at us and we just had to hang on.

meaning.en: 'No comment': there is nothing to tell you.
meaning.zh: 没有什么可以告诉的，常用作拒绝回答的外交辞令。

examples.zh: 记者追问细节，发言人只说：“无可奉告。”
examples.en: When pressed for details, the spokesman simply said, 'No comment.'

examples.zh: 对于这件事，公司表示无可奉告。
examples.en: The company declined to comment on the matter.

examples.zh: 你问我他的工资？无可奉告。
examples.en: You want to know his salary? No comment.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，是常用的推辞语。

meaning.en: Firm and impossible to shake.
meaning.zh: 不能改变或撼动。

examples.zh: 他对理想的信念不可动摇。
examples.en: His belief in his ideals is unshakeable.

examples.zh: 这家公司在行业中的地位不可动摇。
examples.en: The company's position in the industry is rock-solid.

examples.zh: 这是我们不可动摇的原则。
examples.en: This is a principle we will never compromise on.

meaning.en: To use both soft and hard tactics: persuasion and pressure together.
meaning.zh: 软的硬的手段都用上。

examples.zh: 为了让他签字，对方软硬兼施。
examples.en: They tried everything, carrot and stick, to get him to sign.

examples.zh: 家长软硬兼施，孩子终于答应去补习了。
examples.en: After a mix of coaxing and threats, the child agreed to go to tutoring.

examples.zh: 老板软硬兼施，想让员工加班。
examples.en: The boss used both bribes and threats to make staff work overtime.

meaning.en: Depressed and unhappy because something is weighing on one's mind.
meaning.zh: 心里有事，不痛快。

examples.zh: 考试没考好，他一整天闷闷不乐。
examples.en: He moped all day after doing badly in the exam.

examples.zh: 她最近闷闷不乐，不知道出了什么事。
examples.en: She's been down lately; I wonder what's wrong.

examples.zh: 别闷闷不乐的了，出去走走吧。
examples.en: Stop moping and go out for a walk.
